description.value: Oliver Woods Community Centre is a City of Nanaimo public recreation facility on Oliver Road. It is part of the city's network of community and activity centres offering recreation programs and drop-in activities. Touring cyclists passing through south Nanaimo may find it a convenient municipal stop.
